description: Every external native library the production build is permitted to link. The end state for this repository is zero first-party native code; these entries are operating-system and third-party libraries that are consumed, never vendored or modified. build.rs derives its pkg-config package list from this file, so an entry that is not here cannot be linked.
local_modification_ban: No entry may be vendored into this repository, patched, or forked. If an upstream fix is required it is taken from a released upstream version and the pinned version range here is updated in the same change.

packages.purpose: Window, renderer, input and audio device backend.
packages.update_policy: Track the distribution-provided 2.x series. Review release notes for CVEs affecting video, events or audio before raising the floor.
packages.toolchain_impact: Provides include paths, link paths and libraries through pkg-config. Also consumed by the sdl2 Rust crate, which publishes DEP_SDL2_INCLUDE for binding generation.

packages.purpose: PNG decoding for retained native content loading.
packages.update_policy: Security-critical: PNG decoders parse untrusted content files. Apply upstream security releases promptly.
packages.toolchain_impact: pkg-config include and link flags only.

packages.purpose: LZMA decompression for packaged content archives.
packages.update_policy: Security-critical: decompresses packaged content. Verify upstream provenance explicitly, as this project was the subject of a supply-chain compromise in 2024 (CVE-2024-3094); only distribution-signed builds are acceptable.
packages.toolchain_impact: pkg-config include and link flags only.

packages.purpose: bzip2 decompression for packaged content archives.
packages.update_policy: Security-critical: decompresses packaged content. Apply upstream security releases promptly.
packages.toolchain_impact: pkg-config include and link flags on macOS. On Linux the library is linked directly rather than discovered through pkg-config.

direct_libraries.purpose: zlib decompression, required by libpng and by packaged content.
direct_libraries.update_policy: Security-critical: parses untrusted compressed data. Apply upstream security releases promptly.
direct_libraries.toolchain_impact: Linked by name from the platform library path.

direct_libraries.update_policy: Supplied and patched by the operating system; not independently pinned.
direct_libraries.toolchain_impact: Linked by name from the platform library path.

direct_libraries.purpose: bzip2 decompression on targets where it is linked directly rather than discovered through pkg-config.
direct_libraries.update_policy: Security-critical: decompresses packaged content. Apply upstream security releases promptly.
direct_libraries.toolchain_impact: Linked by name from the platform library path.
